quotes.text: What happened to Taylor Swift is a clear example of AI abuse. My bill, the No AI FRAUD Act, will punish bad actors using generative AI to hurt others — celebrity or not. [...] Everyone should be entitled to their own image and voice and my bill seeks to protect that right.

The alarming rise of deepfakes is threatening to destroy innocent individuals' and families' lives. Non-consensual deepfake imagery is a cancer that can no longer go untreated. The TAKE IT DOWN Act is the best way to hold online platforms accountable and protect victims of these horrendous crimes.
AI abuse threatens the ability of Americans to express themselves publicly, both online and in-person. While states like Florida are taking action, Congress needs to address this issue nationwide.

AI has to be in the hands of the United States. [...] if we, the United States, the most benevolent country on Earth, owns that space, we are going to be able to then do medical miracles, we are going to be able to improve our economy.

The rapid rise of artificial intelligence has made it easier than ever for predators to create fake, explicit content that destroys lives. The TAKE IT DOWN Act finally gives victims real legal tools to fight back.

For years, predators hid behind screens while victims were told nothing could be done. Those days are over. This conviction proves the TAKE IT DOWN Act is working. If you target women or children using this technology, you will be found, prosecuted, and locked up. No excuses.

In this new era of AI, bad actors are quickly and easily profiting from the creativity of others. Our laws must catch up. [...] The NO FAKES Act is simple and sacred: you own your identity—not Big Tech, not scammers, not algorithms. Deepfakes are digital lies that ruin real lives, and it's time to fight back.

AI is moving fast, and that is exciting. But no one should have to worry that their face or voice can be copied, manipulated, or used to deceive others. The NO FAKES Act is simple. Your identity belongs to you.
